title: Show an empty claims list with a way to start a claim

fields.summary: As a new claimant, I want to see that I have no claims yet and how to start one, so that I know what to do first.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [screenshot] state: `/claims` signed in as a seeded claimant with no claims; expected: the message "You have no claims yet" and a "Start a claim" button
2. [api-trace] state: GET /api/claims for a seeded claimant with no claims; expected: 200 with an empty list
fields.scenario: Sign in as the seeded claimant with no claims, open the claims list, then call GET /api/claims as that claimant.
fields.environment: local app with the seeded synthetic claimant; never production
